answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 9003 Country: India Title: When i was 15 years old i didnt knew that masturbating breaks fast and it is gunah and i masturbated in roza....and i continued my roza ...now after a year i have came to know that it breaks roza....so my question is what is my punishment for this....should i have to keep 60 fasts!!!!??? Question: When i was 15 years old i didnt knew that masturbating breaks fast and it is gunah and i masturbated in roza....and i continued my roza ...now after a year i have came to know that it breaks roza....so my question is what is my punishment for this....should i have to keep 60 fasts!!!!??? Answer ID: 9003 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2208/1800=B/1429) In the case mentioned above, you have to make qaza of the fasts during which you committed masturbation, but there is no kaffarah : ولو کان مخطئاً او مکرھا فعلیہ القضاء، وکذا اذا نظر الی امراۃ فامنی لما بینا و صار کالمتفکر اذا امنی وکالمستمنی بالکف ( ھدایۃ 1:217 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
